import "date"
import "dict"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Zurich")
names = ["double": "Double", "vario": "Vario"]
d0 = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)
energy = from(bucket: "Homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value" and r.entity_id == "smart_meter_ts_65a_3_energie_reelle_consommee")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, kwh: float(v: r._value) / 1000.0}))
price = from(bucket: "Homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "groupe_e_tarif" and r._field == "price")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, tariff: r.tariff, p: r._value}))
join(tables: {e: energy, p: price}, on: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.kwh * r.p, _field: dict.get(dict: names, key: r.tariff, default: r.tariff)}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
